note: The 打卡 camera (src/ui/camera.js). Hold the right mouse button (or press the camera key) to raise it: the view zooms by `zoom` and names whatever is centred within `reach` metres (farther for anything with its own look reach). A photo of a spot pays `reward` 学习币 the first time only; the saved record is the claim checkin:<id>. A spot matches when the centred look's id or text is in `looks` (or its look box belongs to `owner`), in `place` (town or city; none means anywhere), no farther than `within` metres, and during `hours` [from, to) if given. Voiced lines use the teacher voice: checkin-success and checkin-<id>; the ui words have no clips.
speaker: teacher

hint.zh: 按住右键取景，点左键拍照。
hint.pinyin: Ànzhù yòujiàn qǔjǐng, diǎn zuǒjiàn pāizhào.
hint.en: Hold the right mouse button to frame a shot; click the left one to take it.

local.zh: 照片只保存在这台设备上。
local.pinyin: Zhàopiàn zhǐ bǎocún zài zhè tái shèbèi shang.
local.en: Photos are kept on this device only.

full.zh: 相册满了，最早的照片删掉了。
full.pinyin: Xiàngcè mǎn le, zuì zǎo de zhàopiàn shāndiào le.
full.en: The album is full; the oldest photo was removed.

line.zh: 青禾广场的喷泉，大家都在这儿拍照。
line.pinyin: Qīnghé Guǎngchǎng de pēnquán, dàjiā dōu zài zhèr pāizhào.
line.en: The fountain in Qinghe Square: everyone takes photos here.

line.zh: 词语馆里有很多中文书。
line.pinyin: Cíyǔguǎn lǐ yǒu hěn duō Zhōngwén shū.
line.en: The Word Hall is full of Chinese books.
The lotus flowers are loveliest in summer.

line.pinyin: Zhè shì Qīnghé zuì lǎo de yínháng.

line.zh: 河边文化街有很多老房子。
line.pinyin: Hébiān Wénhuà Jiē yǒu hěn duō lǎo fángzi.
line.en: The riverside street has lots of old houses.

line.zh: 云海中心是云海最高的楼。
line.pinyin: Yúnhǎi Zhōngxīn shì Yúnhǎi zuì gāo de lóu.
line.en: Yunhai Centre is the tallest building in Yunhai.

line.zh: 坐摩天轮可以看到整个城市。
line.pinyin: Zuò mótiānlún kěyǐ kàndào zhěnggè chéngshì.
line.en: From the Ferris wheel you can see the whole city.
The drones are writing in the sky!

line.pinyin: Biān chī huǒguō biān kàn yèjǐng.
line.en: Eat hotpot and watch the night view at the same time.

line.zh: 从这儿看，云海的灯火真美。
line.pinyin: Cóng zhèr kàn, Yúnhǎi de dēnghuǒ zhēn měi.
line.en: From up here, Yunhai's lights are beautiful.

line.pinyin: Zuò dùlún qù duì'àn kànkan ba!
line.en: Take the ferry and have a look at the other side!
